_note: Copy to docs/work/checklist/<yyyy-mm-dd>-<subject>.json. Never fill this file in place. status is pass|fail|skipped|substituted; substituted means checked by a different instrument than the item names, and its reason must say which. accepted stays null until a human answers it, so an unfinished run is visibly unfinished. Delete any item whose feature no longer exists rather than skipping it.

derived.note: Produced by scripts/derive-facts.py at run time, never typed from memory or a previous run.

findings-against-prior-runs._example: Delete this example. One entry per thing an earlier run got wrong — a verdict, a reason, or a step that could not have failed. A checklist that can only describe the current build cannot report that the last checklist lied.

items.expected-result: Release build and pack succeed; the global ai-raccoon tool force-updates to this build and `ai-raccoon --version` matches derived.version
`serve --port 0` binds and reports its port; `serve --restart` on that port cycles the server it finds rather than attaching, and never touches port 7721
memory_write returns a hash for a stored entry; a rejected write returns Stored=false with a reason and no fabricated hash (ADR-0032)
memory_search returns the written entry through hybrid BM25 + vector RRF ranking
memory_get returns the full entry for a hash reachable from the caller; an unknown hash refuses rather than returning empty (ADR-0035)
a `file#section` query returns that exact chunk within the production result window
each registered write-path policy rejects what it claims to, the write reports the rejection, and the rejected content is retrievable from the noise store (ADR-0039)
the refuse and annotate tiers behave as ADR-0040 describes; the structural detector is off until `queryguard structural enable` and only ever annotates (ADR-0041)
memory_watch_status lists live registrations and their sync state
memory_promotion_list reports propose-tier candidates and queue state accurately
every tool in derived.mcp-tool-count and every prompt in derived.mcp-prompt-count is listed and reachable

A watched/ingested code file is searchable via memory_search kind=code (FTS hits carry lineStart/lineEnd and the engine-not-configured warning when no code model is active); kind=memory returns NO code key in the envelope and does not surface the code hit; kind=both returns both sections; the code/both response omits correlationId. Negative control: a memory entry is NOT returned by kind=code.
code_get returns the exact chunk content for a hash from a kind=code hit; an unknown hash is refused with an error, not an empty fabrication.

model set code local against a directory holding a non-768 manifest refuses with an actionable error naming 768 (server-side, not just CLI); a missing manifest surfaces the loader's own error. Scoped to these two refusal legs only — the positive activation path (download + activate) is exercised by 'code-model-one-command-install' below via the #453 one-command install, so this item does not repeat a second live download in the same run.

On a scratch data root with NO code engine configured, `ai-raccoon doctor` prints `code engine: not configured — run 'ai-raccoon model set code default' to enable semantic code search` and `code rows pending: 0`. After ingesting a code file with still no engine configured (so the row lands `embed_state='pending'`), `doctor` reports `code rows pending: N` with N > 0.

`ai-raccoon model set code default` against a scratch data root with no prior download resolves and downloads `faxenoff/code-daemon-embed-v1` into `<data-root>/models/faxenoff__code-daemon-embed-v1`, then activates it — writing embedding.codeModel/codeEngine — with NO manifest hand-edit (#422's done-criterion). Re-running the same command against an already-downloaded directory only re-activates, with no re-fetch. After activation, the code-reindex job drains any pending code rows to 0. The ~187 MB download may be substituted against a pre-downloaded model directory if network egress is infeasible in this run; record as `substituted` naming the pre-downloaded path used.

BEFORE 'code-model-one-command-install' activates the engine: `memory_search kind=code` for a query sharing NO literal token with the indexed code returns a `warning` whose text contains `code engine not configured` and the exact `ai-raccoon model set code default` command, and results come from FTS only. AFTER activation: the SAME query — still sharing no keyword with the stored code — returns the code hit (a dead vector leg must fail this) and the response carries NO `code engine not configured` warning.

AFTER 'code-model-one-command-install' activates the engine, `ai-raccoon doctor` prints `code engine: faxenoff/code-daemon-embed-v1 (<dir>)` naming the activated model's directory, not the not-configured message.

docs/reference/agent-memory-server.md's code-engine section and its compact CLI block document `ai-raccoon model set code default` (not only the two-step `model download` + `model set code local` path) and the 510-token code chunk budget, matching `CodeEngineSetup.DefaultModelCommand` and `EmbeddingService.MaxManifestChunkTokens`; docs/how-to/configure-embedding-engines.md Recipe 5 matches the live command's own output. Run this item only after PR #462 merges — before that merge, agent-memory-server.md still documents only the two-step path, and running this item earlier would report a drift that #462 already fixes rather than a live product defect.

An ai-raccoon.ignore in the ingest root excludes matching files from BOTH corpora on directory ingest (0 chunks; verify a .cs and a .md are both excluded); a bare directory name excludes its subtree; explicit memory_ingest_file of an ignored path returns 0 chunks. Negative control: a non-ignored sibling ingests normally.

memory_watch_add of a path nested inside an existing watch is REJECTED naming the covering watch; adding a broader watch over an existing narrower one prunes the narrower (result lists it); equal-path re-add is an idempotent no-op reporting absorbedBy.

Out-of-box experience: on a FRESH scratch bank with NO code engine configured and the default bundled memory model, memory_ingest_directory over a small mixed tree (.md + .cs) embeds the memory docs (bundled model), chunks the code files to embed_state='pending' via the bundled counting tokenizer, kind=code returns FTS-only hits carrying the engine-not-configured warning, and kind=both returns both sections. Negative control: a deny-set path (e.g. bin/) and an ai-raccoon.ignore'd file appear in NEITHER corpus.

Registering a watch on a scratch REPO ROOT (containing .git/, node_modules/, src/ with code+md): enumeration skips .git and node_modules entirely (zero rows from them, both corpora); src/ feeds both corpora; adding a nested watch inside the repo is rejected naming the covering watch; a live edit to a src file digests into BOTH corpora and the replace prunes the file's superseded chunks.

memory_ingest_file of a file (N chunks), then modifying it so it chunks to a different count and re-ingesting: the superseded chunks are GONE (search no longer returns removed content; chunk set matches the new content exactly). Negative control: a sibling ingested file's chunks are untouched.
Tampering a model file AFTER its manifest was generated (flip one byte) makes model set refuse at activation, naming the sha256 pin mismatch; restoring the byte activates cleanly.

CLI command against a nonexistent bank exits 22 (NoBank); a settings-channel server error exits 23 (SettingsServerError), distinct from usage-error exits. Drive 23 live if a failing server can be arranged cheaply (e.g. point at a dead port); otherwise substituted naming the exit-code test class.

A pushed snapshot blob is framed header+tag and a tampered blob is REFUSED before attach (HMAC verification). Live only if cloud/scratch-backend credentials are available in this run; otherwise substituted naming the SyncService HMAC integration tests.
